events.title: Ashen Swarm demo is now available on Mac
events.summary: The Ashen Swarm demo is now available on macOS through Steam. Download the free demo and join the fight: Play the demo If you run into a problem on Mac, please let us know in the Steam discussions. Include your Mac model and macOS version so we can investigate. Thank you for playing and helping us improve Ashen Swarm!

events.title: Demo 0.80 — Big Balance Patch & No Mercy
events.summary: The Windows demo has a big balance update. Build around a new universal perk, revisit familiar abilities and face a different mix of enemies in the later waves. New perk: No Mercy Available to both heroes, No Mercy grants 20/40/60 percentage points of critical-hit chance against enemies with an active negative effect. events.title: Demo 0.78 — Corruption, the Collegium and a clearer Codex
events.summary: Demo 0.78 is now available on Windows. The macOS demo remains on version 0.77 for now. In 0.78, Unbound abilities grow with Corruption, and the Collegium responds with more dangerous moves at higher tiers. We have also updated the Codex, tooltips and enemy movement around obstacles. This post covers every change since 0.76.5, including the fixes already released in 0.77. Update highlights Corruption abilities unlock in stages: Threadweaver gains a strike at T2 and healing at T3. events.title: Demo 0.76.5 — The Court, clearer upgrades and progression
events.summary: Demo 0.76.5 is now available on Windows and macOS. A reworked Court battle, clearer upgrade cards, a new way to inspect the Effigy, and fixes based on your feedback. Here is what has changed since 0.75. The Court and your run results Reworked the arrival of the Court. The previous enemies and encounters are cleared, and the full Court takes its places before the Foreman's introduction. events.title: Update 0.75 — Corruption, combat effects and clearer choices
events.summary: Thank you for the gameplay clips and detailed feedback. Version 0.75 is now available, bringing together the changes made since our last news post about version 0.72. Corruption and combat The Threadweaver’s Corruption ability now ends its pull with a damaging strike and returns part of the health taken from enemies. events.title: Demo 0.72 is live — improvements since Serbian Games Week
events.summary: The Windows demo of Ashen Swarm is now on version 0.72. Thank you to everyone who played during Serbian Games Week, shared a gameplay video or told us where a run became confusing. Watching your runs has helped us see which parts of the game needed a clearer explanation. If you last played the festival demo, here are some of the changes made since then. events.title: Ashen Swarm’s free demo is live — Serbian Games Week
events.summary: Ashen Swarm is a dark-fantasy bullet-heaven roguelite. Mix powers from Wrath, Pride and Gluttony to build your arsenal and tear through hordes of the condemned. Choose whom to save or betray, and face the consequences in later runs. Try the free demo during Serbian Games Week, September 21–28. Play the free demo on Steam Enjoyed the run? Add Ashen Swarm to your wishlist for the full release.
